relevance_note: Multicentre Indian SAID cohort whose Table 3 describes four individually labelled patients with heterozygous TNFAIP3 variants under 'A20 haploinsufficiency (TNFAIP3) (n=4)', with narrative detail for Pt. 40 and Pt. 41.
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; values were entered by hand into a Python builder script in my scratch directory, which slices table spans directly from the paper text (bullets are followed by a non-breaking space) and checks every span verbatim. Scope: only Table 3 rows Pt. 40-43 (TNFAIP3) plus two relatives of Pt. 40 (mother, carrier; younger brother, affected with recurrent oral ulcers and tested negative: 'the younger sibling does not carry this variant'); the brother therefore has no variants row. The other 45 tabulated patients have variants in other genes and get no rows. Labels: the tables use 'Pt. N' for every patient; the text varies ('Patient 40', 'Patient no 40' in the Figure 7 legend, 'Patient 41'). I used the table form 'Pt. 40'..'Pt. 43' consistently. Table 3 is patients-as-rows; the column header 'Patient (age of diagnosis, years/sex)' defines the age in the label cell as age at diagnosis; 'Age of onset of symptoms' column gives Pt. 40 '6 M' (others NA). The text says Pt. 40 'was 2 years old when she had presented' - treated as presentation, not onset, so not recorded as onset. Mother's variant: the paper says 'same variant' as Pt. 40; I recorded c.1504C>T for her with the Pt. 40 cell as a second span. Pt. 40 inheritance recorded as 'inherited maternal' from 'Mother is carrier for the same variant' (father not reported as tested). variant_type_as_stated left 'not reported' for Pt. 41 (c.1316_1317del; p.Gly440ArgfsTer4) because the authors do not name the class in words, and for Pt. 42/43. Pt. 40's text calls the variant 'novel' but gives no pathogenicity class, so pathogenicity is 'not reported'. Checklist: 'ANA, ANCA: negative' (Pt. 40) is a narrower absence and does not exclude 'autoantibodies (ANA/other)'; 'Gut Biopsy: no vasculitis' is site-limited and does not exclude 'vasculitis'; both left 'not reported' on the checklist but recorded as excluded phenotypic_features. Pt. 42 'Direct coombs test 3+' was not used to mark autoantibodies; 'AIHA' (abbreviation not defined in the table notes) was used for cytopenia (autoimmune). Pt. 43 'Osteomyelitis/CGD' (CGD undefined) was not taken as recurrent infections. CNS involvement for Pt. 40 is based on persistent headache and papilledema. Table 3 cells marked NA were treated as not reported. No legend defines '-' symbols; none were used. Study inclusion/exclusion criteria were not used as evidence. Publication: cohort_size_as_stated = 78 ('Remaining 78 patients'), from 107 collated; clinical details are given for 49 (the Discussion says '8/49' died). The paper states some patients were reported earlier (refs 14, 17, 19, 26, 27; tables also cite 29-32), but no HA20 patient is marked as previously reported. Inconsistencies noticed (none within the HA20 rows): abstract gives non-inflammasome conditions as 30 patients (41%) vs 38% in Results; Table 3 title n = 16 because Blau patients are omitted; Table 3 LACC1 rows refer to 'Pt. 49 and 50' although rows are Pt. 47-49.
